text:
The dish is a small round compostable plate, roughly 18-20 cm across. It holds about 4-5 pieces of cooked steak, sliced and seared, medium-rare in the middle.

The pile of meat covers about 8 cm by 9 cm and is roughly 2 cm thick. That works out to about 100-120 g of meat.

Cooked steak is roughly 2.2-2.5 kcal/g, depending on how fatty the cut is. At about 110 g, that gives roughly 250-270 kcal.
